result.summary: Fixes an off-by-one minimum field count check in `contrib/seeds/makeseeds.py` so that lines with fewer than 12 whitespace-separated fields are skipped. Also adds unit test coverage for `parseline()` to verify handling of valid and truncated seeder records.
result.problem: `parseline()` intended to skip malformed or incomplete lines but only checked `len(sline) < 11` while later accessing `sline[11]` for the user agent. An input line with exactly 11 fields bypassed the guard and raised an unhandled `IndexError`, aborting seed generation instead of ignoring the line.
evidence: Fixes #36146: 'contrib: makeseeds.py parseline() raises IndexError on lines with exactly 11 fields'
The code previously checked `len(sline) < 11` before reading `sline[11]`, causing an `IndexError` on 11-element lines when parsing seeder outputs.
result.card: Fixes an off-by-one field check in `contrib/seeds/makeseeds.py` and introduces unit tests for line parsing. The script previously checked for fewer than 11 whitespace-separated fields before accessing index 11 for the user agent, causing an unhandled `IndexError` that aborted seed generation if a line contained exactly 11 fields. The PR changes the check to require 12 fields and adds unit tests covering truncated inputs.
